name: Xuan Xing
biography: Xuan Xing is the tech lead of the Android Red Team at Google. For the past years, Xuan focused on finding security vulnerabilities in various low level components of Android/Pixel devices. He is passionate about software fuzzing for security research. In BlackHat USA 2022 Xuan presented the “Google Reimagined a Phone. It was Our Job to Red Team and Secure it” talking about Pixel ABL security auditing.
